2598: The shinigami whispered of among the female students of Shinyo Academy, few people know that Boogiepop actually exists. Rumors say that that Boogiepop is a reaper that kills people when they are at their most beautiful point in life.
2609: The alternate protagonist of the Boogiepop Series. She is an ordinary student at Shinyo Academy, the girlfriend of Keiji Takeda, and a good friend of Kazuko Suema.
2610: Suema was the last target of Dr. Kisugi, the serial killer of 5 years ago. From this, Suema gained a very high interest in criminal psychology which makes her a bit of an outcast among her classmates.
2815: Masami Saotome is one of the antagonists of Boogiepop Wa Warawanai. He is a student at Shinyo Academy who would later become the Manticore's primary accomplice.
25743: During Nagi's stay in the hospital, she met a detective whom she forged a special bond with. His name was Shinpei Kuroda, an undercover agent of the Towa organization. His dream to become a defender of justice left a mark on Nagi's life.
34922: One of the evolved humans, known as enemies of the world, from the Boogiepop series of light novels. Minahoshi Suiko, already 'dead' when she is introduced as the second book begins, continues to exist as The Imaginator.
40330: Aya is an agent of the Towa Organization, under the orders of Spooky E, who was sent to investigate the Pillar of Light left by Echoes.
68019: An imperfect clone of Echoes (an alien sent to Earth to evaluate humanity) created by the Towa Organization and is considered a monster. It escaped from the lab it was created in, hoping to preserve its life. "Manticore" means "man-eater".
75576: Kamikishiro Naoko is a third year student at Shinyo Academy, and going out with both Kimura Akio and Tanaka Shiro. Though known to be a kind, happy-go-lucky girl, she often sings Life is Brief. By chance, she finds Echoes collapsed in the street, and is compelled to help him.
133503: Kei Niitoki has the tendency to stick her nose into other people's business; once she sees a problem, she wants to fix it. This personality tick lead her to becoming th president of Shinyou Academy's moral's committee.
133506: A being who took upon the form of the final stage of human evolution.
134391: Jin Asukai is an esper, a college student and part-time art teacher and councilor at a cram school.
134393: Kotoe Kinugawa is a student at Shinyo Academy and the cousin of Jin Asukai.
134394: Spooky E is a synthetic human and agent of the Towa Organization, along with Aya Orihata, sent to investigate Echoes' pillar of light, who later targeted Boogiepop.
134395: Masaki is a middle-school student and the non-blood-related younger brother of Nagi Kirima.
136561: A young female doctor who discovers a Towa Organization 'evolution-drug' by accident and begins experimentation on her patients.
136562: Seiichi Kirima is a famous novelist and non-fiction writer, the deceased father of Nagi Kirima, and the idol of Kazuko Suema.
136563: Pigeon is a member of the Towa Organization, working as a messenger delivering orders to different agents.
136564: Masanori is an assassin working for the Towa Organization, disguised as a normal businessman.
136565: Gen is a master at martial arts and was the one who taught Nagi Kirima and Masaki Taniguchi. He was formerly best friends with Nagi's father, Seiichi Kirima. Now, Gen wanders around the world.
157038: Shirou Tanaka is a member of Shinyo Academy's Archery Club, one of Naoko Kamikishiro's boyfriends, along with Akio Kimura, and a friend of Kentarou Habara.
